localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description:
Bowl & Pitcher Lower Campground, Sound-emitting electronic equipment is prohibited. Parking for 20 cars. Tents only. No RVs or trailers.
Groups having a special event or wedding must contact the park in advance at (509) 625-5553 for approval.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.

localizedValues.name: C1-Spruce
localizedValues.description: This ADA accessible cabin is 20-by-20 feet in size and has a queen-size futon, bunk bed that sleeps three, table that seats four, small end table with a lamp, microwave, refrigerator, and restroom with a sink, toilet, and shower. Outside is a picnic table and wood burning fire pit. Personal camping stoves are allowed outside. All cabins are heated and have a ceiling fan, but visitors should take along blankets and warm clothing as evenings can be cool. There is no air conditioning. Cabin is to be cleaned by occupant prior to departure. There are two parking stalls for each cabin, with one being an ADA parking stall. No pets. No propane, charcoal, or wood stoves inside the cabin.

localizedValues.name: C2-Tamarack
localizedValues.description: Pet Friendly, $15 per night pet fee applies. Maximum of two pets. Declare pets and pay fee when you make reservation or at park when you check in. Read and understand pet rules. This ADA accessible cabin is 20-by-20 feet in size and has a queen-size futon, bunk bed that sleeps three, table that seats four, small end table with a lamp, microwave, refrigerator, and restroom with a sink, toilet, and shower. Outside is a picnic table and wood burning fire pit. Personal camping stoves are allowed outside. All cabins are heated and have a ceiling fan, but visitors should take along blankets and warm clothing as evenings can be cool. There is no air conditioning. Cabin is to be cleaned prior to departure. There are two parking stalls for each cabin, with one being an ADA parking stall. No propane, charcoal, or wood stoves inside the cabin.

localizedValues.name: S1-CCC Kitchen Shelter
localizedValues.description:
This shelter has a wood burning fire place, three electrical outlets, sink, and six picnic tables. Picnic tables can be moved outside the shelter. Rental of the shelter doesn’t guarantee exclusive use of the surrounding area. Hours for the shelter are from 9am to one hour prior to dusk. Parking is variable and can become congested with other park users. Most visitors come for the recreational opportunities and don’t disturb events that are taking place.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.
